idempotency.retention: As long as the command's effects exist. The key is the command's durable identity: save it before the first attempt and reuse it to retry or recover. Never reuse it for a new business intent.

parameters.description: Filter by reservation status. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by merchant or order ownership. Omit to return every owner type. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.description: Filter merchant-owned reservations by exact owner key. Combined with owner_type=order, returns an empty page.
parameters.name: owner_key

parameters.description: Filter by the original Idempotency-Key, after trimming surrounding whitespace. Matching is exact and case-sensitive. Returns current authorized resources, not the recorded response. A pending resource does not prove that the operation succeeded, and an empty list does not prove that it had no effect.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

parameters.description: True selects reservations with at-risk quantity; false selects reservations with none on any line. Omit for all reservations.
parameters.name: has_at_risk_quantity

parameters.description: Filter by how the reservation ended. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
